issue.title: Deep Agent task delegation fails through the synchronous CLI entry point

steps: Please delegate this job to your general-purpose sub-agent rather than doing it yourself: the sub-agent should create the file report/total.txt containing only the sum of 17, 25 and 58. When the sub-agent has finished, read report/total.txt back and tell me what the sub-agent did and what the file contains.
expected: In deep mode, delegate the requested computation to the general-purpose sub-agent and return its file/output.
defect: Calling task through synchronous agent.invoke raises StructuredTool does not support sync invocation, preventing delegation.

fault location.explanation: The task tool is implemented as async def.
The native CLI invokes the graph synchronously, entering the synchronous tool path.

Root cause: SOURCE-CONFIRMED ENTRY-POINT MISMATCH. The task tool has an async implementation, but the native deep-mode CLI uses synchronous agent.invoke. The archive contains ten h1-repro runs and an offline scripted-model reproduction reporting NotImplementedError from StructuredTool. This conclusion is specific to the synchronous entry point; ainvoke was not tested here. Archived model: DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash, source and ABB binding revisions recorded separately. No new execution or first-fixing-commit verification was performed; fixed_in remains unknown.
